<NAME>
two_strike_grim
</NAME>

<DESCRIPTION>
Cooperate initially and forgive one opponent defection, then defect permanently after a second defection. This preserves mutual cooperation with mostly cooperative strategies while retaining near-full protection against persistent defectors.
</DESCRIPTION>

<CODE>
```python
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def policy(own_history, opponent_history):
    return 0 if opponent_history.count(1) < 2 else 1
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
```
